source_semantics.single_shape_configuration: MatmulImplBase::SetSingleShape delegates once to SetTail; SetTail configures the MLoop, NLoop, and KLoop single shapes before IterateAll.
source_semantics.n_major_iteration: MatmulNormSchedulerBase::MoveOnIterateOrderN advances N after M completes, then invokes MLoop::InnerStart for the next source-local N tile.
source_semantics.dynamic_m_branch: MLoopNormBase::SetSingleShape takes the tiling-derived branch when enableSetTail is true; the static M16 control uses the fixed configuration branch with enableSetTail false.
source_semantics.candidate_boundary: The source establishes a five-N opportunity for dynamic-M loop-control instructions, but establishes neither their Scalar-pipe cost nor a Forward service. Only the independent PipeUtilization control may decide whether a stable service exists.

forward_eligibility.required_next_evidence: The full-A five-N dynamic-M1/static-M16 PipeUtilization control at independent K2048 and K4096 endpoints.
